key.name: show-current-context
key.description: Whether to show the current cluster name next to the panel icon

key.name: panel-icon
key.description: Kubernetes emblem style for the panel icon: white or color

key.name: cluster-poll-interval-seconds
key.description: Seconds between cluster reachability polls for each context

key.name: kubeconfig-paths
key.description: List of kubeconfig files and directories. Directories are scanned recursively for files.

key.name: merge-kubeconfigs
key.description: When enabled, set KUBECONFIG to all configured paths joined with colons

key.name: active-kubeconfig
key.description: Currently selected kubeconfig path, or empty to use the first configured path

key.name: active-cluster
key.description: Internal key identifying the selected cluster (name + kubeconfig path)

key.name: active-cluster-name
key.description: Display name of the currently selected cluster
